name: Stepper
description: A numeric input with increment/decrement buttons. Renders a flex row with a minus button, a centered value display, and a plus button. Uses the Button component internally for the controls.

notes: Minus button is disabled when value <= min, plus button is disabled when value >= max.
Value display uses aria-live='polite' so screen readers announce changes.
Each button has a descriptive aria-label ('Decrease value', 'Increase value').
Focus indicator uses box-shadow with var(--color-border-focus) via the Button component.

size.description: Size variant controlling height and font size.

disabled.description: Disables both increment and decrement buttons.

className.description: Additional CSS class names applied to the outer wrapper.

do: Use for numeric values that change in fixed increments (quantity selectors, settings).
Provide min and max constraints when the value has logical bounds.
Use a visible label adjacent to the Stepper to clarify what the value represents.
dont: Do not use for free-form numeric input — use Input with type='number' instead.
Do not use for very large ranges — consider Slider for continuous ranges.
Do not omit a label — if a visible label is not possible, provide aria-label on the container.
